This error contradicts the generally accepted knowledge that Hughesville, MD, which corresponds to ZIP code 20637, is located in Charles County. This error propagated confusion and delayed the resolution process. The mistake could have been avoided with a simple cross-reference using reliable county or ZIP code lookup tools.
